name: comp-149

frames.best_why: Most days are filled white while Saturday stays empty and Sunday stays dim and disabled.

tagline: Choose active weekdays with a row of round letter buttons.
summary: Seven circular toggles, one per weekday, each showing its first letter. Tapping a circle fills it solid white; the last circle is permanently dimmed and does not respond.
appearance: Under a small "Days of the week" heading, seven equal circles line up on a near-black stage. Chosen days are solid white with dark letters, untouched ones are dark with a thin outline, and the final circle is faded almost to the background.
behaviour: Clicking a circle flips it between solid white and dark outline, so several days can be on at once; the final circle ignores clicks because it is disabled. Hover and keyboard focus ring the circle under the pointer.
demo_content: The legend "Days of the week" and the letters M T W T F S S.
use_when: A schedule or availability form needs a compact row for choosing which weekdays apply.
avoid_when: Four days start ticked and Sunday is permanently disabled, with the start state hardcoded.
customise: The days and their starting ticks come from an items array, while circle size and the disabled Sunday are fixed in the file.
weight_why: Seven small circles and hidden checkboxes with one colour transition.

a11y.note: Hidden full day names back the single letters and the row rings on focus, but the colour transition ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The disabled Sunday is barely visible against the dark background.
polish_why: Neat circular day row with clear on and off states; the disabled circle nearly disappears.
title: Weekday Picker Checkboxes
